user_story: As a guest, I want to filter bookings by status so that I can see only pending, confirmed, or cancelled reservations.

positive.title: Filter bookings by status to show confirmed reservations
steps: Navigate to the bookings page as a guest.
Verify the displayed reservations match the confirmed status.
positive.expected_result: Only confirmed reservations are displayed successfully.

negative.title: Filter bookings by non-existent status
steps: Navigate to the bookings page as a guest.
Select a status filter that does not exist (e.g., 'Completed').
Verify the system's response to the invalid filter.
negative.expected_result: An error message is displayed indicating the status is not valid.

edge.title: Filter bookings when there are no reservations
steps: Navigate to the bookings page as a guest.
Verify the displayed message when no reservations exist.
edge.expected_result: A message is displayed indicating no reservations found for the selected status.
